method: merged fold of the two divergent published forks of the 1109 after-warm-multiband chain head: this lane's cost-68d + warm band hygiene fold (class-frontier-cost68d-recompute-20261115.json, solved 1117) and the concurrent lane's warm multiband 2 fold (class-frontier-warm-multiband2-recompute-20261115.json, solved 1140). The receipt sets are pairwise disjoint (published duplicate crosscheck: 31 batch-2 roots vs the 13 cost-68d/hygiene roots, intersection empty, zero WIN/LOSS conflicts; the batch-2 selection explicitly deferred the hygiene bits 62a 1/89, 63a 11/109 and 61d bit-22 = 71b bit-1 and never touched the cost-68d band). This script reproduces the published 1140 chain head by runpy (asserted 1140/6707/528979/4977/392702, byte-identical output), re-derives the cost-68d child membership at the 1140 state with string keys (genuinely still remaining, demand c1=0,c2=2,c4=0), re-sums the completed cost-68d sweep from the 9 published raw batches (68 candidates, 61,325,518 v16 nodes, 7 WIN7-D10 + 61 REFUTED + 0 capped) with the node-exact determinism rerun and the v15 cross-engine anchors asserted, then folds the 13 receipts in the published record order, re-deriving every per-record marginal from the growing union that already contains the 31 batch-2 receipts. Each certificate was extracted with the repo-verbatim blind extractor (FBS=1<<20, fbt_drops=0) and independently verified with verify_win7_certificate_bigint_independent.mjs; remote bytes were verified byte-exact by git blob sha after landing. No sweep claims are made here beyond the published cost-68d sweep record - receipts only

controls.fork_disjointness: the 31 warm-multiband-2 roots and the 13 cost-68d/hygiene roots are disjoint; the fold order (batch-2 first, this lane's 13 second) cannot create double coverage because every marginal is re-derived from the growing union

cost68d_child_membership_at_1140.claimed_as: cheapest remaining unswept child of the third class-2 coverable target S5 (claim at the 1109 state, commit 6175d233; swept by this lane as the cost-68d sweep)
cost68d_child_membership_at_1140.note: the 31 batch-2 receipts never covered this child; it is genuinely still remaining at the 1140 state, and the 7 cost-68d WIN7 receipts folded below close it

outstanding_not_folded.parallel_lane_bands: cost-65h/67b/68c warm candidates and the in-flight cost-65j sweep stay with the parallel lane, as do the six gain-1 cost-70c warm candidates (parallel-lane band)
outstanding_not_folded.warm_candidates_without_records: gain-0-in-manifest own-lane warm candidates deferred by the batch-2 selection (incl. cost-61d bit-8 and others); they advance no manifest orbit until the solved set changes
outstanding_not_folded.note: the six gain-1 cost-70c warm candidates may now have non-zero marginal against this merged head; their fold belongs to the parallel lane (its band) or a later canonical recompute

interpretation_guard: bookkeeping over published receipts; REFUTED-D10 sweeps prove only absence of WIN7-D10; WIN7 certificates prove a win within depth 10 from the 7-stone root only; solved counts measure manifest coverage, not the game-theoretic value of the 11x11 empty board; 11x11 empty root / {49,60} / S2 {59,60} / class 2 / class 4 remain UNKNOWN
